text: Track 2.2 The topic is a bit too complex to be honest. I guess it doesn't help that working with medical equipment isn't really my area of interest either. Well, I'm sure the lecture was recorded, so you could try listening to it again online. That's a good idea, though I'm not sure my understanding of it will improve the second time either. Hmm, I still think you should listen to it. I'm sure you'll understand more than you did the first time. Also, you ought to pause the recording and make notes about the key points as you listen. Yeah, it'll take a long time, but I need it for my essay. Yes, Gemma. Wouldn't you rather do that than miss something important? I imagine the essay will take quite a bit of work, and you only have two weeks. Don't remind me! But you are right. What about anything I'm still not sure about? Well, I might be able to help you, but you might want to consider doing some extra research. Maybe you can find some research papers online, or in the University Library, and acquire the knowledge you need to make things clearer. That'll be useful. I need to understand this topic better if I want to get a good mark when I hand the assignment in. You have a meeting with your advisor on Wednesday, don't you? Yes, that's right. Well, I recommend you ask her about it, too. She was really helpful when I had my last tutorial. Great suggestion. I'm sure she will be able to explain a few things. That'll really help. Okay. Right. Well, you only have a few days so you should consider starting. Your advisor won't be happy if you don't prepare something for the meeting. Ha, no. Right. So where did I put my laptop?
